Missing materials (notebook, 3 leather strips, thread, needle and a writing tool)
Missing materials (notebook or 5 sheets of paper and a writing tool)

Your pen teaches what your skill proves. You can write perk books when you are 2 levels above the skill in question (volume 1 from level 4; level 10 lets you write volume 5). Each book consumes an empty notebook, 1 thread use and 3 leather strips; a needle and a pencil are required but not consumed.
Without your daily comics you get unbearable. If you spend 6 hours without reading comics or magazines, you gain 10%% unhappiness, boredom and stress every 30 minutes.

Your body rejects any drink. Drinking alcohol gives nausea as high as your drunkenness level (completely drunk means maximum nausea), plus 10%% unhappiness and stress per level. The effects decay along with the drunkenness.
Behind the wheel everything goes wrong. Passengers of the vehicle you drive take 25%% more damage from accidents (you take this damage too).
Your repairs barely hold. Your clothes are twice as fragile to wear and holes.
Learning next to the best makes you feel small. While within 4 cells of a player at least two levels above you in a skill, you gain 20%% less multiplier on that skill.
Your head has been smooth as stone for as long as you remember. You start bald and your hair never grows back.
Asphalt and dirt are no match for your soles. Your feet always have 80%% protection, even when barefoot.

You need to see blood daily to stay calm. If you go more than 2 hours without seeing or interacting with blood (on your body, clothes or weapons), you start gaining 10%% stress, unhappiness and boredom every hour.
Reading comes naturally to you: you grasp every idea on the fly. Perk books give 25%% more experience multiplier.
You love books: a good reading session always does you good. Any book, skill books included, removes unhappiness, stress and boredom.
Reading really costs you: the pages resist you. Perk books give 25%% less experience multiplier.
Your flat tone kills the conversation. Players within 6 cells of you gain boredom twice as fast, and so do you. If you are alone, the trait has no effect.
You fight carelessly and end up drenched. You get covered in blood 25%% faster than the rest.
Your diet is simple: meat, period. Eating well-cooked or canned meat removes 20%% stress, unhappiness and boredom, on top of the benefits it already gives.
Your medical touch leaves a lot to be desired. First aid actions performed on others take you twice as long.
Wearing anything means feeling comfortable. No piece of equipment or clothing produces discomfort.
You cook wildly, without measure or order. Every ingredient you add to a preparation provides 15%% less proteins, calories and satiety.
Every mile is torture. Driving any vehicle increases 5%% stress, unhappiness and boredom for every 100 meters driven while moving.
The engine is your medicine. Driving any vehicle reduces 5%% stress, unhappiness and boredom for every 100 meters driven while moving.
Drunk, you are better party entertainment than a fighter. Melee damage is reduced 20%% per drunkenness level.
Boozing awakens a fighter out of this world. Melee damage increases 10%% per drunkenness level.
You recharge in company. You lose unhappiness and stress while within 4 cells of other players (10%% every half hour).

Your hands know their job in the middle of chaos. Performing first aid on others no longer requires their confirmation, and just opening the other's health panel stops their bleeding (it resumes if you stop checking on the patient without bandaging or stitching them).
Grime follows you everywhere you go. You accumulate a flat 10%% of dirt every hour.
Your feet are glass. When barefoot, they have 80%% more chances of getting hurt.
People feel at ease around you. Players within 4 cells of you gradually lose unhappiness and stress (10%% every half hour).
Your mane knows no scissors. Your hair grows 50%% faster than normal.
Laughter is contagious. Players within 6 cells of you never gain boredom, and neither do you. In both cases boredom decays gradually, not at once, to keep it realistic.
For you comics never run out. You can read comics and magazines 4 times before their re-read cooldown kicks in.
Every stitch strengthens what it touches. Your clothes are twice as resistant to wear and holes (they get damaged once every two times).
Your pot is a neighborhood legend. Every ingredient you add to a preparation provides 10%% more proteins, calories and satiety.
Oddly, blood soothes you instead of terrifying you. Blood on you, your clothes or weapons removes unhappiness, stress and fear, the exact opposite of hemophobia.
When a group of zombies grabs a player, you can shove them ALL with a single shove (up to 10 in one push), with a 100%% chance of knocking them to the ground.

Every person for themselves. If a group of zombies grabs a player within 8 cells of you, you deal 95%% less damage and gain maximum panic and stress. It only goes away if you leave or the player dies.
Crowds drain you. You gain stress while within 4 cells of other players (20%% every half hour).
Driving gives you a moment of clarity: your drunkenness is suppressed while you drive, but the party goes on once you stop.
The virus seeks your body but never finds it. Zombification reaches 90%% and is fully removed: you never turn.
Your body is a poor host for the virus. Zombification increases twice as fast.

Your imagination makes the apocalypse more bearable. You can write leisure books, magazines and comics that remove between 5%% and 40%% unhappiness, stress and boredom (each state with its own random chance). Books consume an empty notebook, 1 thread use and 3 leather strips; magazines and comics consume a notebook or 5 sheets of paper. A pencil is required but not consumed, and you can name your works when you finish them.
You have a weakness for them, even zombies. You deal 15%% less damage to male zombies and gain 8%% stress and unhappiness for each one you kill.
Men set your nerves on edge, alive or dead. You deal 10%% more damage to male zombies and lose 2%% stress and unhappiness for each one you kill.
Healing others gives you a will to live. Performing first aid, on yourself or others, removes 5%% unhappiness, stress and boredom per action.
Just seeing bandages turns you the color of death. Performing first aid, on yourself or others, increases 5%% unhappiness, stress and boredom per action.
Your experience is contagious. Players within 4 cells of you gain 20%% more skill multiplier, but only on skills where you are at least two levels ahead of them.
You transform at sunset. From 10 pm to 4 am, your unhappiness and boredom can only reach 25%%.
Your engine never knows exhaustion. You never suffer muscle fatigue: that mechanic is off for you.
Your body overheats at the slightest effort. Muscle fatigue grows twice as fast.
Texts get on your nerves: reading only gets you worked up. No leisure book removes negative states (magazines aside) and reading any kind of book gives 10%% stress, 10%% boredom and 10%% unhappiness.
You drive with a steady hand and checked seatbelts. Passengers of the vehicle you drive take half the damage from accidents (you still take full damage).
You fall like a cat and get up like one. Falls from any height deal 50%% less damage.
Tobacco smoke turns your stomach. Smoking gives 15%% nausea and unhappiness per cigarette.
Your legs give way at any fall. Falls from any height deal 20%% more damage.
Your stomach is delicate and any stench turns you. Bad smells raise the 'something smells bad' state twice as fast.
Nothing beats your hardened nose. Bad smells do not affect you: the 'something smells bad' state never rises, under any circumstance.
Nobody withstands your shove. Pushing zombies knocks them 20%% to 80%% further back (random) and they have 25%% more chances of falling.
You know how to squeeze everything to the last drop. Your drainables are spent once every two uses: they last twice as long.
Nothing fits as it should. Every piece of equipment and clothing is 50%% more uncomfortable than normal.
Your presence sours everyone around you. Players within 4 cells of you gradually gain unhappiness and stress (10%% every half hour).
Your image is everything and you draw on it in adversity. While made up, your stress and unhappiness cannot exceed 50%%.
The smell of meat disgusts you. Eating meat or anything containing it has no positive effect and also gives 30%% stress and unhappiness.
Everything slips through your fingers. Your drainables are spent two at a time instead of one: they last half as long.
Your arms could not lift a shadow. Pushing zombies has 70%% fewer chances of knocking them down.
You have a weakness for them, even zombies. You deal 15%% less damage to female zombies and gain 8%% stress and unhappiness for each one you kill.
Women set your nerves on edge, alive or dead. You deal 10%% more damage to female zombies and lose 2%% stress and unhappiness for each one you kill.
Your hands were not meant for a needle. Repairing or patching clothes uses twice the thread and scraps.
